event: 2026 ILCA SENIOR EUROPEAN CHAMPIONSHIPS & OPEN EUROPEAN TROPHY
procedural_matters: SLO 221181 was represented by Luka ZABUKOVEC.
NED 211003 was represented by Thomas VAN OFWEGEN.
facts: SLO 221181 finished race 3 and was towed back half-way.
SLO 221181 arrived onshore, washed and de-rig the boat, packed the sail and covered the boat, which lasted approximately 20 minutes.
At some point during those actions, SLO 221181 had a small talk with NED 211003 about the incident, then went to his van and took the phone.
SLO 221181 submitted the hearing request at 18:31:47.
The protest time limit for the ILCA 7 Men Blue fleet was 18:30.
conclusions: SLO 221181 failed to deliver the protest within the protest time limit, as required by RRS 60.3(b)(1).
There was no good reason for the international jury to extend the time limit.
decision: The protest is invalid, the hearing is closed under RRS 63.4(a)(1).
